title: Orbifold Mapping Spaces via Bibundles
summary: The existence of orbifold structures on mapping spaces between orbifolds was established in previous work, notably by W. Chen and B. Chen-Du-Liao. In this paper, we construct an infinite-dimensional orbifold structure on the mapping space in a more geometric way, using bibundles (or Hilsum-Skandalis morphisms), based on Lerman's description of orbifold morphisms. We construct a proper étale (or Fréchet) Lie groupoid representing the mapping space in the $C^k$, $C^\infty$, and $W^{k,p}$ settings, and show that its Morita equivalence class is independent of the choices of groupoid…
